# Kraken fixtures

Hand-written from Kraken's public REST API documentation for `GET /0/public/Ticker`
(https://docs.kraken.com/api/docs/rest-api/get-ticker-information), because api.kraken.com is
blocked from the development network (ADR 0006). Values are illustrative; the shape (legacy
`XXBTZUSD` / `XETHZUSD` names next to newer ones like `SOLUSD`, arrays of strings) follows the docs.
